Academic Common Market
The purpose of the Academic Common Market (ACM) is to share specified academic degree programs between states located at southern public colleges and universities (part of the Southern Regional Education Board – SREB). This is accomplished through an exchange of students across borders at in-state tuition rates. https://www.sreb.org/AcademicCommonMarket
The ACM is a Tuition Savings program for college students in 15 SREB states who want to pursue degrees that are not offered by public institutions in their home state.
The ACM is not competitive or merit-based, but students must meet state residency requirements and college admission requirements.
ACM Overview
Students must:
Be a resident of one of the 15 SREB states
Contact ACM or the state coordinator to determine eligible programs (please note that Texas only participates in graduate level programs)
Apply for and be accepted into an approved ACM program
Apply for certification from a student’s home state ACM coordinator
Students will then be granted an out-of-state tuition waiver.
The ACM enables students to pursue eligible degree programs via distance or e-learning without leaving their home state, work and other commitments.
Texas Residents
Texas residents looking to study out of state, the first step is to confirm that a comparable program at the same degree level is not already offered at a Texas public university. Visit this site to search for degree programs in Texas: https://acmi.sreb.org/acm/s/program-search-page-public
For specific questions about Texas participation, send an email to ACMrequests@thecb.state.tx.us or call Jessica Acton at (512) 427-6214.
Residents of Other Participating States
Residents looking to study at Texas A&M-Kingsville, should contact the ACM coordinator at student’s home institution or home state. The contact information for each participating state can be found on the ACM web site.
Once, the student is approved, the Texas State Coordinator will communicate with the Texas A&M ACM Coordinator who arranges with the appropriate institution officials.
